title: CitizenshipBackExtractionSchema
description: Patched schema for structured data extraction from the back of a Nepali Citizenship Certificate, including certificate details, thumb impressions, and all required text blocks.

citizenship_no.description: Certificate number exactly as printed in the top certificate details section; all digits and hyphens included.

sex.description: Sex of the certificate holder as printed (e.g. 'Male', 'Female').

full_name.description: Full legal name of certificate holder as printed in the English/Devanagari block.

dob_year.description: Year of birth (AD) from the joined label-value row.

birth_district.description: District of birth as printed in the Birth Place label.

birth_rm_mn.description: Rural Municipality (R.M.) or Municipality (M.N.) of birth as printed.

birth_ward_no.description: Birth place ward number as printed.

perm_municipality.description: Permanent address municipality as printed (English or Nepali, don't guess, transcribe).

perm_ward_no.description: Permanent address ward number as printed.

nepal_citizenship_act_sentence.description: The Nepali legal statement below the top bordered box: 'नेपाल नागरिकता ऐन २०६३ बमोजिम यो नागरिकताको प्रमाणपत्र दिइएको छ ।' Extract in full as printed.

citizenship_type.description: Type of citizenship as specified in the section labelled citizenship type/kisim (e.g. 'वंशज'). Extract exactly as printed in Devanagari.

certificate_holder_signature_label.description: The full label text above the left thumb area: 'प्रमाण पत्र वाहकको दस्तखत:' or its variant.

right_thumb_impression.description: If thumb impression mark is present in the right box, set to 'present', otherwise 'absent'.

left_thumb_impression.description: If thumb impression mark is present in the left box, set to 'present', otherwise 'absent'.

right_thumb_label.description: Label text for right thumbbox e.g. '(दायाँ) औंठाको छाप'.

left_thumb_label.description: Label text for left thumbbox e.g. '(बायाँ) औंठाको छाप'.

issuing_officer_signature.description: Signature field: return the officer's handwritten signature as printed if legible, otherwise 'unreadable signature' or 'present'.

issuing_officer_name.description: Name of the issuing officer (नाम थर) as printed to the right of the signature.

issuing_officer_designation.description: Designation (दर्जा) of the issuing officer as printed below the name.

issue_date_bs.description: Official issue date as it appears in the lower right issuing authority box (in BS). Include all numerals and dashes.

remarks.description: Bottom-of-page instruction: 'यो प्रमाणपत्र कसैले भेट्टा पर्नु भएमा नजिकको जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालयमा वा प्रहरी कार्यालयमा बुझाइदिनुहोला ।' Extract as printed.
